mapper.select: SELECT i.img_block_id AS imgBlockId, i.img_id AS imgId, i.original_name AS originalName, i.image_url AS imageUrl, i.caption AS caption, i.order_index AS orderIndex, i.created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM image i3 WHERE i3.img_block_id = i.img_block_id AND i3.deleted_at IS NULL) AS totalCount FROM image i WHERE i.img_block_id IN #{id} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.order_index = ( SELECT MIN(i2.order_index) FROM image i2 WHERE i2.img_block_id = i.img_block_id AND i2.deleted_at IS NULL )
